blocks.raw: Points as incentives are treated as currency within an org and its affiliates. The multitude of credits, debits, and adjustments impact the pool of points in the customer account. When points issued from different programs of the org can be redeemed across the org units or loyalty programs, it is important to understand the debit and credit history. Ledger APIs help you retrieve the points debit and credit details across the programs of the org.
